description: BioBoost is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Biomass potentials > BioBoost", published or maintained by bioboost.iung.pl (publisher inferred from the link). BioBoost Geoportal with maps: Assesses potentials for NUTS3 regions in the EU27 (EU28 minus Croatia) and Switzerland. Data does not appear to be openly available in tabular form; data can be requested by email. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Biomass potentials" lists it under "BioBoost". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support biomass potential inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
licence: not stated on the wiki page (source page not read)
